sections.text_helper: Section 23.4.8 "COMP startup stabilization time" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 717.
sections.section_content:
The comparator parameters and its output is undefined after the COMP is enabled
(power-on) for a period defined as startup stabilization time. See the product datasheet for
more details. If the comparator output is driving any critical stage of the design, it is
recommended to redirect the comparator output to the device I/O through the GPIO
alternate function or through IP configuration (such as timers) after the stabilization time
elapses.
